lsp_envelope_rename.stale_daemon_caveat: Daemon dir is version-scoped: ~/.mpd/lsp-daemon/v<package.json version> (lsp package version 0.2.3; daemonPaths() :5604-5620, resolveDaemonVersion() :5571). An already-running daemon at the SAME version keeps the old code in memory, so after the rename the ping at :5739 reads params['_omo'] as undefined -> authError (-32001 daemon_authentication_failed, :5477); the protocolVersion check at :5360-5363 can only run when the envelope is present at the expected key, so the skew presents as an AUTH error, not protocolError. The client's probe then sees a null ping (:5713-5721) and ensureDaemonRunning spawns a fresh daemon (:5692-5703) which cannot take over the live same-version socket; waitUntilReachable expires -> DaemonUnreachableError (:5685-5689) — loud, never a silent misroute. Remedy: rm -rf ~/.mpd/lsp-daemon (or point MPD_LSP_DAEMON_DIR at a fresh dir / bump the version so a new v<version> dir is created) and let it respawn.
